spectacle:1:
The house
inhabits my dreams
my nightmares

It towers over the vast landscape
far surpassing its physical counterpart
in sheer size and scape

The aging brown brick stood still and desperate
The green shingles on the roof sat with a certain
narcissistic destructiveness

I still remember the first time I laid eyes on it
It will haunt my dreams forever

Is it really the house though?
Or is it the shadows within myself
which saw the light of day within its walls?

Nostalgia disguised as presence

Build a shrine to the spectacle
Light a candle for the spark of recursion
Pray to the self inflated symbology

psion:1:
Presumptive and assured
I think that I know better
Really I’m just judging myself
And you’re a stand-in for
my deepest wounds

If I can figure out
How to love you
Maybe I can live
Maybe I can sleep
Maybe I can quit
Grinding my teeth

It seems fitting that
Moving forward means
To act in good humor

And see myself in
Your less than
Flattering traits
psion:2:
Putrid smell of hatred and resentment
Permeates throughout your existence

People look to you for answers
Instead you dump on them
Emotionally and otherwise

You resent silence and peace
I try to be kind and patient
You take this as an attack

As if I am calling you weak
By simply seeing the thorn
In your foot and attempting
To tend to it and pull it out

Your inner voice is a tyrant
Control as a way to soothe
So is anger and vengeance
I hope that you find your way

You say you are a truth seeker
You lie to yourself all day long
While we sit there and listen -
to you babble, rant, and rave
And nominate yourself arbiter

Truth isn’t black and white
You are not God, we all are
Truth requires many lenses
It has perspective and tonality
Such depth that is unfathomable

You know you should forgive
But your desire for vengeance
For wishing ill consumes you
The love in your life wilts
